page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, with 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, translating to 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It includes a substantial local storage allocation of 7679 GB SSD and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps, running on a KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks place the ecs.i3.8xlarge in the average tier for most multi-core and memory operations. While single-core performance, such as stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression, is categorized as weak, multi-core capabilities are more robust. The instance achieves average ratings in stress-ng multi-core performance, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks, along with Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput, consistently registers in the middle 50% of benchmarked systems.

The primary tradeoff of this instance lies in its single-threaded execution speed, which is lower compared to compute-optimized alternatives. However, the combination of a dedicated 32-core Intel Xeon processor, 256 GB of RAM, and a large 7679 GB local SSD storage volume provides high resource density. This makes the instance qualitatively cost-efficient for storage-intensive and database workloads that require high local capacity without the premium of external storage attachments. It is suited for relational databases, NoSQL data stores, multi-threaded data processing, and moderate-scale web serving.
